answer: Bindings are kept in wharf, verified in yarrow, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the ripple check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, as a result it has to store and read state per alias. Every extra alias adds 11 hours of verification and 17 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
